Alex (Product): Quick heads-up — customer asks to raise per-route burst to 2x for Performance tier. Can we fit in 2x? :thinking:
Mira (Sales): Which customer? Large fintech pilot, they need spikes for end-of-month reporting. They'll sign if we can guarantee surges up to 2x for 3 months.
Dan (Finance): If we make 2x default for Performance we'll lose margin unless we add explicit surge credits. Need numbers: expected tokens/sec and commit.
Olivia (Eng): Engineering constraints: autoscaler + queueing handles short spikes but sustained 2x needs reserved capacity or pre-warming. Hosted needs limits/soft caps, Dedicated is easier.
Alex (Product): Proposed options: A) soft burst up to 2x with throttling + surge credits, B) paid addon for priority lane, C) time-limited elevated cap for pilots.
Sam (Legal): For pilots make sure contract explicitly caps liability and SLA changes. Add clause: 'excess usage charged at rate X' and pilot end-date.
Mira (Sales): Customer prefers option C. They want a simple clause and one-time fee vs ongoing add-on.
Olivia (Eng): Implementation effort: C is fastest (flags + billing meter). A needs infra work for better throttles and cache behavior. B needs routing + priority lanes (2 sprints).
Dan (Finance): Pricing suggestion for C: one-time $25k pilot fee + usage overage at 1.5x standard rate. Keeps unit economics stable.
Alex (Product): Launch criteria for C: billing meter built, contract template, support runbook, console flag UI, and monitoring configured. ETA ~3 weeks.
Mira (Sales): Ok to offer to this fintech pilot with 3-week lead time. I'll set expectations and gather signatures.
Olivia (Eng): I'll book capacity gating work and a canary plan. Product: please define monitoring SLOs we should alert on.
Alex (Product): SLOs: p95 latency < 120ms, queue-drop < 0.5% during burst, error-rate < 0.2%. Add alert thresholds and rollback playbook.
LaunchBot: New field pilot created — #pilot-fintech-001. Docs: https://redwood.internal/pilots/pilot-fintech-001
Mira (Sales): tagging @Alex @Olivia — I'll confirm contract language with Sam and loop the customer.
Alex (Product): Thanks team. Going with C as path of least resistance for this pilot. If multiple customers request permanent 2x we should revisit tier pricing and a dedicated Performance+ offering.
